name: poll-widget
title: Poll Widget
blurb: Full-featured poll with multiple rendering modes (inline, popover, dialog) and…
description: Compound component (Root, Content, Question, Options, Option, Results, Submit) for polls with three display modes. Tracks selection and votes. Shows results live and auto-collapses after voting. Supports success message feedback. Can be…
use_when: In-app polls, surveys, or feature voting that should feel polished with multiple display options.
avoid_when: Anonymous surveys (votes visible to all users at once).
a11y: Fully keyboard-navigable options. Dialog mode uses aria-modal. Popover uses role=dialog. Success message announces via motion component.
